items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I always delighted in the story of Kaiser Marshall -- [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: And that was the sound from there, from the Tiger Rag. And then the drummer would get ready for his solo and he'd run all over the place and play on the tables and chairs and all. But this is -- they call that getting hot.
Well, I always delighted in the story of Kaiser Marshall --
